listing.name: Aliceworks Hull Mods
listing.summary: Adds several new hull mods that alter ship stats, armor, drive performance, and cargo capacity.
listing.aiSummary: Adds several new hull mods that alter ship stats, armor, drive performance, and cargo capacity.

description: Adds several new hull mods that alter ship stats, armor, drive performance, and cargo capacity. These mods include options for increased armor, experimental drive fields, fighter bay conversions, and smuggling compartments. They currently only work with base stats and are designed for specific ship types rather than all vessels.
